2609.22609.title: From Documented Strengths to Force Limits: Material-Informed Robotic Insertion for Construction Assembly
2609.22609.paper_summary: Insertion is a fundamental operation in robotic construction assembly, where variations in material properties and assembly conditions make it difficult to select contact forces that complete the task without exceeding the assembly's capacity. Although construction documents encode engineering knowledge about materials and their conditions, translating this knowledge into load limits for a specific assembly remains difficult. This paper presents SAGE (Source-grounded Assembly Gating and Execution), a system that converts documented material evidence into capacity estimates for robotic insertion. SAGE restricts a large language model (LLM) to extracting tensile and compressive strengths from retrieved passages and tables and records their sources. A response model then interpolates offline finite element (FE) solutions to convert these strengths and the assembly conditions into axial load capacity. For fits with positive clearance, the estimated capacity sets the policy's axial force limit; for interference fits, it is compared with measured support demand to determine admission. On the primary benchmark, SAGE reduces mean capacity error from 80.65\% for direct LLM estimates based on the same evidence to 10.74\%. Without refitting, the mean error remains 8.00\% on 16 additional geometries. Under the assigned support release model, SAGE correctly classifies 59 of 62 scored simulation runs, with only conservative errors. In recorded xArm6 demonstrations, SAGE takes material documents as input and completes physical insertion in 9 of 13 trials. These results show that assigning document interpretation to the LLM and force calculation to an explicit mechanical model produces accurate capacity estimates and traceable insertion decisions.
2609.22609.paper_summary_zh: 插入是機器人建造組裝中的一個基本操作，材料特性和組裝條件的變化使得選擇完成任務而不超過組裝能力的接觸力變得困難。雖然建築文件編碼了有關材料及其條件的工程知識，但將這些知識轉化為特定組裝的負載限制仍然困難。本文提出了SAGE（基於來源的組裝閘控與執行），這是一個將記錄的材料證據轉換為機器人插入能力估算的系統。SAGE限制大型語言模型（LLM）從檢索的段落和表格中提取拉伸和壓縮強度，並記錄其來源。然後，響應模型插值離線有限元（FE）解，以將這些強度和組裝條件轉換為軸向負載能力。對於具有正間隙的配合，估算的能力設置政策的軸向力限制；對於干涉配合，則將其與測量的支撐需求進行比較以確定是否允許。根據主要基準，SAGE將基於相同證據的直接LLM估算的平均容量誤差從80.65\%降低到10.74\%。在不重新調整的情況下，16個額外幾何形狀的平均誤差保持在8.00\%。在指定的支撐釋放模型下，SAGE正確分類62次評分的模擬運行中的59次，僅出現保守性誤差。在錄製的xArm6演示中，SAGE將材料文件作為輸入，在13次試驗中完成9次物理插入。這些結果顯示，將文件解釋分配給LLM，並將力計算分配給明確的機械模型，能夠產生準確的能力估算和可追溯的插入決策。
